name: dsh-qq-onebot-bridge
description: QQ ↔ DeepSeek Harness agent bridge over OneBot v11 (reverse WebSocket). v0.4.0 "Everything Debuggable": a trace id on every message, a Chinese reason on every silent drop, structured JSONL events, live SSE event stream with per-message decision chains, one-click diagnosis, diagnostic-bundle export, inbound recording with offline sandboxed dry-run replay and event injection (never touches QQ), a 6-hard-constraint acceptance page — plus the usual per-group/per-user sessions, @-quote voice speech-to-text (GLM-ASR / OpenAI-compatible), quote & image resolution, face/sticker tools, agent media tools, session resume, moderation and group-insight packs, and a standalone control console (control/) that starts/stops the host and watches every port. Independent bundle; remove anytime: dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-qq-onebot-bridge
